handoff: A cluster starts a route like a planet node. Node id = Clusters.node_id(i) = -(1000+i), stored in route 'a'; src key 'cluster:<id>'. main.send_from_cluster(node, dst) buys a ship if needed. Skill hook: Clusters.MINING_SKILL ('B1') checked in RouteEngine.check_cluster and main.can_mine(); T158 only needs B1 to become Prospecting. Each cluster gives mining_yield_per_cycle per cycle shared by its ships, never more than is left; empty cluster stalls its lane, never refills. EV20 pay spawns one small cluster (mining_event_cluster_richness) beside a planet chosen by cycle number (no RNG). Ore parked at a planet is cut by the existing cut_capacity. Map API for T157: main.clusters_in_system(sid) gives index, node, id, system, x, y (planets.json units), radius, count, visible (thins with richness), left, max.

details.new_data: data/asteroid_clusters.json: 5 clusters (2 system 1, 3 system 2), fields id, system, x, y, radius, count, good; event_cluster shape for the EV20 cluster. The first mining_clusters_sN entries of a system are active.
details.save_format: New top-level key 'clusters': {left: {cluster id: units}, spawned: [full records]}. Old saves without it load with all clusters full. Cluster routes save as normal routes (a = -1000-index, b = planet, c = ore); they load without the skill check and stay when the cluster is empty (stalled). Spawned cluster indexes come after base clusters, so node ids stay stable.
